feeds.title: Beauty and the Bay
feeds.description: I would share with the world some of my best secrets and recipes. I am known to be a wonderful cook and baker and have so many wonderful recipes and stories to share with you all. I love spending time in nature or by the sea and living around the bay allows me to do just that.

feeds.title: Inside Newfoundland and Labrador Archaeology
feeds.description: I have been employed as an archaeologist for more than 20 years. Through my fieldwork experience and office work, I can access documents written by archaeologists dealing with the archaeological sites of Newfoundland and Labrador. My discussions are in no particular order of relevance or importance. Some of these sites are very well known in the public sphere others are completely unknown.

feeds.title: Crumb Top Baking
feeds.description: I'm Leanne and welcome to Crumb Top Baking! I'm a recipe developer and food photographer living in St. John's, Newfoundland, Canada. I specialize in healthier desserts and savory dishes, including a mix of dairy-free, vegan, and gluten-free recipes. My love for baking and cooking goes back to my teenage years! The kitchen has always been my comfort zone and experimenting with different foods and ingredients is my way of de-stressing and finding balance.

feeds.title: Newfoundland Buzz
feeds.description: Our love for Newfoundland & Labrador spawned this media network. Newfoundland Buzz covers the latest news, media, and entertainment. We aim to entertain and archive life here on the island. It is a passion project turned business venture under Covid-19 lockdowns. The majority of our content is strictly editorial in support of local businesses across NL.

feeds.title: Visit Newfoundland and Labrador Blog
feeds.description: We will make Planning your Trip to Newfoundland and Labrador easy and convenient. On our websites, you can find suggested itineraries, accommodations, rental cars, flights, hotels, things to do, tours, and other activities. We've built an extensive partner network to give our customers different accommodation choices.

feeds.title: Product of Newfoundland
feeds.description: Product of Newfoundland is a blog about Newfoundland stories, trivia, and culture. My name is Robert and I'm a product of Newfoundland. I grew up in a small Bonavista Bay community called Happy Adventure. My first 'real job' had me teaching elementary school science in a tiny island community with no cars. At about the same time I started teaching, I began writing Product of Newfoundland. It became a bigger deal than I'd ever anticipated.

feeds.title: Targa Newfoundland Blog
feeds.description: Held on the Island of Newfoundland on seaside roadways and through quaint villages, the Targa Newfoundland is motorsport's ultimate road rally, a thrilling challenge to test your skills and abilities. Nowhere else will you get to race through towns and villages at full speed; nowhere else will you enjoy the people, the culture, and the hospitality of one of North America's most beautiful destinations.

feeds.title: Landsby Blog » Newfoundland
feeds.description: Browse our blog for authentic experiences and unique getaways, and explore the best of Newfoundland. Landsby creates unique and immersive experiences that not only provide travelers with purposeful and enriching trips but aim to positively impact the communities being explored. We are supporting and rebuilding Canada's tourism sector through innovative collaborations, storytelling, and a focus on Indigenous and Regenerative travel.

feeds.title: Arts Newfoundland
feeds.description: Arts Newfoundland.ca is a news and media organization that focuses on the arts and culture of Newfoundland and Labrador.

feeds.title: Bonita's Kitchen
feeds.description: Bonita's Kitchen is a popular cooking show on YouTube and EastLink Community Television, based out of Newfoundland, Canada. The show is hosted by Chef Bonita Hussey, who shares her love for cooking traditional Newfoundland meals and recipes.

feeds.title: Just a Foodie
feeds.description: I am a person who has been cooking for my family, friends and the public for over 25 years. My blog is dedicated to the people and places that showcase good, unpretentious , comfort food in Canada and the United States. My professional background is in the event and tourism industry , I take great interest in culinary tourism and finding a authentic experience both tourist and locals expect!

feeds.title: Routinely Nomadic » Newfoundland
feeds.description: Check out our blog for newfound land articles. We're Dean Johnston and Laynni Locke, a Canadian couple that hit the road in 2008 and now can't imagine doing anything different. Our devotion to hiking can be traced in large part to three separate trekking visits to the breathtaking Nepal Himalaya.

feeds.title: The Food Girl in Town
feeds.description: I'm a full-time freelance writer living in St. John's, Newfoundland with my husband Adam. I love to learn new things, I'm passionate about food history and I am always thinking 'Where next?' My dream destination is Tibet, while India and Nepal are high on the list.

feeds.title: Live Rural Newfoundland & Labrador
feeds.description: Christopher Mitchelmore of Green Island Cove founded Live Rural NL as a blog in 2010 out of a passion for sharing the Great Northern Peninsula and rural life in Newfoundland and Labrador with the world. The website will continue to tell stories of traditions, heritage, art, people, business, and local landscapes while promoting our travel and tourism industry.

feeds.title: TravelWorldOnline » Newfoundland
feeds.description: Check out articles about new foundland. This travel blog gives travel tips for those travelers who want to explore Europe and the world intensively and take their time to look behind the scenes. It is aimed at those who want to discover their destination in all its facets, and are ready to leave their everyday life at home and looking for a break with pleasure.

feeds.title: The Newfoundland Distillery Co
feeds.description: The Newfoundland Distillery Company was founded in 2016 by William Carter and Peter Wilkins to celebrate the terroir of Newfoundland and create distinctive spirits using local ingredients. The distillery is the first craft distillery in Newfoundland that uses locally grown barley as the base spirit for many products. All of our spirits celebrate and focus on the purity of ingredients from the shores of Newfoundland.

feeds.title: NLhomefinder Blog
feeds.description: NLhomefinder showcases Newfoundland & Labrador's finest properties with an exceptional searching and viewing experience, using the most innovative technologies currently available. NLhomefinder agents offer the ultimate service and communication, with professional speed, efficiency, and accuracy. Their years of full-time experience have given them a clear understanding of the mindset of home buyers and sellers and a thorough comprehension of the regional and local marketplace.

feeds.title: John Gushue Blog
feeds.description: I am John Gushue, a journalist with CBC News in St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. I'm taller than I look. This blog has been running quietly since 2004.
